title: Contingency Carried in a Funding Lot where a Micro Market has Been Closed Off
content:
A closure on an Unattended Micro Market Program agreement over the trailing year moves the contingency carried in the next funding lot, and whether stock loss was also charged over that year settles which way it moves.

## Points of judgement

**When is the low contingency carried?** Where a suspension request stands approved on the agreement over the twelve months to the day the lot is worked out, and a shrink adjustment stands on the agreement over those twelve months, the low contingency of 5 per cent applies, the market having sold less and lost stock while it was shut.

**When is the high contingency carried?** Where a suspension request stands approved on the agreement over those twelve months, and no shrink adjustment stands on the agreement over them, the high contingency of 15 per cent applies.

**And where the market was not closed off?** Where no suspension request stands approved on the agreement over those twelve months, no such change to the contingency share is made.

## How the contingency acts

The contingency is taken once on the whole cover need, and not on the monthly figure before the cover months are applied.

*Hypothetical.* A cover need before contingency of 7800.00 USD on an agreement carrying an approved suspension request and a shrink adjustment over the trailing year becomes 8190.00 USD. The same agreement with the suspension but no shrink adjustment over that year gives 8970.00 USD.
